changeSet.author: SDooley
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.Tables WHERE Name = N'ASSETTAG' AND Type = N'U') BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.AssetTag( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AssetID] [int] NOT NULL, [TagID] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetTag] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY]) END
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetTag_AssetID] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] ( [AssetID] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, DROP_EXISTING = OFF, ONLINE = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetTag_TagID] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] ( [TagID] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, DROP_EXISTING = OFF, ONLINE = OFF) ON [PRIMARY]
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.Tables WHERE Name = N'ASSETTAG' AND Type = N'U') BEGIN DROP TABLE dbo.AssetTag; END
